name: Enterprise MCP Template
description: A production-ready framework for building enterprise-grade MCP servers featuring integrated OAuth 2.0 authentication and modular architectural patterns. It simplifies the creation of secure, standardized tools that allow AI assistants to interact with complex upstream platforms like Salesforce and NetSuite.
